# 📈 Chapter 5: Stocks

::: info 🎯 In this chapter
Shares, trading, IPOs and reading a stock page.
:::

## Units in this chapter

1. [What a Share Is](/stocks/5.1-what-a-share-is) - Understand share ownership, why prices move, market cap, dividends, splits, bonus shares and indices.
2. [How Trading Works](/stocks/5.2-how-trading-works) - Understand order matching, market/limit/stop-loss orders, settlement, delivery vs intraday, and circuit limits.
3. [IPOs and Listing](/stocks/5.3-ipos-and-listing) - Learn how IPOs work in India, including UPI application, allotment, lot size, listing risk and SME IPOs.
4. [Reading a Stock Page](/stocks/5.4-reading-a-stock-page) - Learn to read price, volume, EPS, P/E, book value, ROE, debt-equity ratio and promoter holding on a stock page.

::: tip 📖 How to read
Go in order. Every new term is explained the first time it appears, and each unit ends with a keywords table.
:::
